attorneys: Louis E. Torinus, Jr., Eldon M. Martin, Elmer B. Collins and Mar-cellus L. Countryman, Jr. for appellants., Arnold H. Olsen, Attorney General of Montana, H. M. Brickett, Assistant Attorney General, and Edwin S. Booth for appel-lees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the District Court for further proceedings in the light of King v. United States, ante, p. 254, decided this day.
